# Relay

> Relay is a shared WebMCP planning workspace where humans retain approval authority and agents move structured work forward.

## Public links

- Application: https://relay.alx21.chatgpt.site
- Source: https://github.com/agammann/relay-webmcp
- Demo: https://youtu.be/ztukxIXQ3rA

## WebMCP tools

- `get_workspace_context`: Read the shared project, task, agent, blocker, approval, and activity state.
- `list_ready_tasks`: Find agent tasks whose dependencies and task packets are ready.
- `claim_task`: Assign an eligible ready task to an active agent.
- `update_task_progress`: Record progress, time, blockers, and missing information without completing work.
- `submit_deliverable`: Send a deliverable to the visible Human Inbox for review.
- `request_human_input`: Ask the human owner for a clarification or decision.

## Authority boundary

Agents can claim work, report progress, submit deliverables, and request clarification. Approval, rejection, clarification answers, deletion, and project finalization remain human-only actions in the visible interface.

## Updates

This file describes the public Relay application and its current six-tool WebMCP surface.
